failures.summary: Lakekeeper returned PostgreSQL deadlock-backed HTTP 503 errors in every contention round.
failures.detail: All six rounds completed setup, warmup, sequential commits, final-state attribution, MinIO object-growth audit, and cleanup, but every round violated zero-request-errors. The transcript records 58 HTTP 503 responses: 11 in conditioning and 47 across the five measured rounds. Reviewed Lakekeeper logs attribute the responses to CatalogBackendError after PostgreSQL reported a deadlock while setting table properties. PostgreSQL logs show concurrent DELETE plus INSERT ON CONFLICT UPDATE statements on table_properties waiting on transaction ShareLocks. Expected stale Iceberg races are classified separately as HTTP 409 conflicts; these 503 responses are catalog backend failures and therefore remain unranked. This Lakekeeper path uses PostgreSQL and is unrelated to LakeCat's Turso state store.

failures.summary: Nessie returned request-context HTTP 500 errors in every contention round.
failures.detail: All six rounds completed setup, warmup, sequential commits, final-state attribution, MinIO object-growth audit, and cleanup, but every round violated zero-request-errors. The transcript records 106 HTTP 500 responses: 18 in conditioning and 88 across the five measured rounds. Reviewed Nessie logs show jakarta.enterprise.context.ContextNotActiveException because the RequestScoped context was inactive while resolving CatalogProducers' objectIO producer during an asynchronous writeObject call from CatalogServiceImpl.storeSnapshot. These responses are non-conflict catalog errors under concurrent writes, so the strict result remains visible but unranked.
